_comment: Proposed from the FEAT-003 security pass (2026-10-23). Each criterion is already covered by a passing attacker test in apps/web/src/app/api/projects/security.test.ts; promoting them to features.json makes them permanent gates. Import with: python3 scripts/kit.py import (human only).

features.title: Sign in with GitHub and private projects

acceptance_additions.check: User B creating/listing/revoking a token on user A's project id gets 404 and never affects A's tokens
POST /api/projects ignores owner_id / id in the body; the created project is always owned by the caller
PATCH /api/projects/[id] with any field other than name returns 400 and leaves the project row unchanged
Deleting a project cascades to its tokens: the token's plaintext is rejected with 401 by GET /api/token/whoami
